findings.title: The question turns disputed fact into specified consequence
findings.claim: The officials' question moves the exchange from disputing what happened to asking the accused to state the consequence that would follow if their denial failed, making the sanction part of a jointly articulated rule.
findings.mechanism: The recompense carrier at 12:74:3:1 meets the separate liar predicate at 12:74:6:1; the trusted anchored finding treats that contact as the officials' eliciting of an outcome that the accused themselves define.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the question as a procedural turn: the answer will not merely describe the alleged theft, it will supply the rule that governs what follows.
findings.containment: The ordinary penalty and recompense question remains intact. The co-authorship claim is confined to this exchange and does not assert that every questioner shares one plan or that the exchange states a universal legal code.

epistemic.reason: The citable cross-run support is trusted and carries exact focus anchors at 12:74:3 and 12:74:6 together with both supplied branch references.
